I still can't reproduce it, so I haven't changed any code. Nothing changed after my last message either: I only investigated and asked for an example, so the app behaves exactly as before.

This time I checked your saved meetings in the app's local database. I read a copy in my scratch folder and didn't touch the real one.

- **Newest meeting is May 27.** Nothing is saved after that, so whatever you saw since then never made it into the database. Either it didn't save or it ran from a different install.
- **Active mode is General, not Team Meet.** So the "things I would do" wording I suspected last time isn't in play. General's action-items section just says "Tasks and follow-ups identified."
- **Saved recaps do keep dateless items.** The May 18 "Research Project Verification Meeting" recap lists "Share the draft with others, such as Doctor Yu", which has no date.
- **None of your saved transcripts has a "someone will do X" line that's missing from its recap**, so I can't find a real instance of the bug.

Changing a prompt now would be a guess. To get further I need one of these:

1. **The meeting where it happened:** roughly when it was and which app or install you were using. If it's the "Priya will send the contract" one, it isn't in this database.
2. **Your go-ahead to run a test transcript** through the end-of-meeting summary using your API key. It costs a few cents. I'd run each version a few times, with and without a date, since the output varies run to run.
